The data items are: Data item Data type Comment the unique ID of the student who has borrowed the book StudentID STRING The first three characters of a StudentID represent a tutor ID. Each student has one tutor. BookID STRING the unique ID of the book being borrowed OnLoan BOOLEAN TRUE if the book has not been returned The programmer has defined a global array Loan to store 8000 loan records. There are more elements in the array than books in the library. Unused elements have the StudentID set to an empty string. These may occur anywhere in the array.
